source.note: EXPERT MASKS SUPPLIED WITH THE DATASET - no segmentation model was run. Subject s1045 of the TotalSegmentator dataset v2.0.1 (Zenodo 10047292), CC BY 4.0: a LIVING patient, study type 'ct polytrauma', pathology field 'no_pathology', age 62, male, Siemens Somatom Force, 100 kVp, intravenous contrast (aorta median about 380 HU), resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic by the dataset authors. 645 axial levels from the skull vertex to mid-thigh, arms at the sides. Masks were drawn and reviewed by the dataset's authors, not by us.
